neighbours.label: A full stop ending a prose sentence rather than a comma linking the same clauses.
fire: The report described the samples. The appendix listed their sources.
The museum opened in April. Visitors arrived before noon.
The editor approved the paragraph. The printer received the draft.
The window faced the garden. The door led to the hallway.
The survey ended in June. The team published its findings.
The dictionary gives a definition. The next entry offers an example.
The meeting lasted an hour. The secretary recorded the votes.
The letter mentioned the shipment. The receipt confirmed its arrival.

notes: The target is broad (1.616% above 0.1 of max) and mostly gate-closed leakage (94%); all six top peaks contain periods. Controls preserve words and order while replacing the sentence boundary with a comma.
